power_grid.classification: heuristic, not actual infrastructure dependency mapping
power_grid.rule: Correlated alerts are not proof of shared cause; no auto-repair or isolation

rhythm.interpretation: Same-window changes are correlations only; no shared root cause established
rhythm.boundary: Never execute repair, blocking, or repository changes from rhythm signals

phase.limits: Single nearest pair can be coincidental. Hourly Actions cadence is not exact. No verified infrastructure dependency.

heartbeat.policy: 3 consecutive complete inventory observations for persistent review; no auto-repair; quiet != unhealthy

scope: Public repository metadata only. No code execution, scans, vulnerability claims, or automatic actions.

diaspora.correction: Detect and quarantine mismatched records in the report; do not rewrite repository data.

feedback.boundary: Only complete public inventories update feedback; no repository changes or firewall actuation.

witnesses.finding: public GitHub API; not an intrusion attestation

feedback.boundary: Only complete public inventories update feedback; no repository changes or firewall actuation.

egress.outcome: observation recorded; no firewall or repository mutation

diodic.boundary: Every cycle begins and ends with FORMIC; evidence is not authority to execute
